Original research article, not a review. The paper cites its earlier work [51, 78] for the general correlation of uptake with surface area but does not state that every H2 uptake value was published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. Sorbents are sucrose-derived template carbons (N-C, B-C series) and phenolic-resin KOH-activated carbons (C-1 to C-18). H2 uptake is also shown at 140, 183 and 298 K (Figure 3) and at room temperature (Figure 8).
